text:
rachel.k: Quick kickoff 1 SableBank POC needs: IdP-initiated SAML, SCIM (delta + groups), Okta->RBAC mapping, delegated tenant admins, tenant-level domain proofing across multiple brands, EU-only residency, and standard security questionnaire answers. Need runbook + rough Hosted vs Dedicated pricing for presales call. Who can own?

ben.s: I can own the runbook. quick clarifying Q: what's expected SCIM burst rate and full-sync cadence? that'll affect hosted quota vs dedicated recommendation.

liu.y: Sales intel: ~6.5k users, ~1.8k DAU. nightly full upsert at 02:30 UTC, deltas during day with bursts ~1500 ops over ~20m (onboarding windows). high contractor churn. they want JIT for a couple apps and SCIM as primary for others.

anna.p: We can emit group claims in the SAML assertion and use a custom claim name. nested groups are not auto-expanded server-side; recommend flattening at the IdP or a small sync lambda. also flag assertion size limits for very large group lists. i'll add caveats to the runbook.

ben.s: i'll add sample SAML attribute snippet + a SCIM PATCH example to the runbook. will also include testing steps for metadata exchange and assertion signing checks.

qa-bot: qa-bot: Draft estimate uploaded: https://redwood.s3/prequotes/sablebank-estimate.pdf :eyes: 

rachel.k: Sales needs a ballpark for the call tomorrow morning to keep momentum. any quick topline numbers?

anna.p: Off-the-record prelims (subject to PM/legal): Hosted (standard quotas) = ~$1.0k/mo; Hosted + SCIM quota bump = ~$2.6k/mo; Dedicated onboarding (one-time) = $16k; Dedicated recurring (reserved throughput) = ~$5.5k/mo. EU region premium may apply.

liu.y: They also asked if wildcard or delegated domain proofing is supported to speed multi-brand onboarding.

ben.s: GA product requires exact domain verification per tenant. wildcard/delegated domain proofing is not GA. we can offer delegated proofing as an engineering SOW for Dedicated/Private deployments (est ~3-5 weeks dev + QA). i'll mark that optional in the proposal.

rachel.k: Good. ben please include the SCIM PATCH example and SAML metadata exchange steps in the runbook. i'll schedule the tech call for tomorrow 11:00 CET and add sec/ops. i'll update CRM with the draft quote link.

ben.s: SCIM PATCH sample for delta replay:
curl -X PATCH "https://eu.api.redwood.com/scim/v2/Users/abc123" \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"Operations":[{"op":"replace","path":"emails","value":[{"value":"user@sable.brand"}]}]}'

anna.p: SAML attribute example to include in runbook:
<Attribute Name="roles">
  <AttributeValue>compliance_viewer</AttributeValue>
  <AttributeValue>payroll_admin</AttributeValue>
</Attribute>

liu.y: Thanks team 53 keeping momentum. :thumbsup:
